    • setUserStyle

      public void setUserStyle(int foregroundColor, int backgroundColor, int edgeType, int edgeColor, int windowColor, @Nullable String typeface)
      Sets a custom user caption style, as if the user had chosen custom caption options in the system settings.

      CaptioningManager.getUserStyle() then returns a CaptioningManager.CaptionStyle with these values.

      Parameters:
      foregroundColor - The text color.
      backgroundColor - The color behind the text.
      edgeType - The edge type, for example CaptioningManager.CaptionStyle.EDGE_TYPE_OUTLINE.
      edgeColor - The edge color.
      windowColor - The color of the window that contains the captions.
      typeface - The typeface family name, for example "monospace", or null for the default typeface.
